title: Oven temperature sensor open circuit
shortDescription: RTD temperature probe disconnected or open.
fullDescription: F1 on Fisher & Paykel ovens indicates the oven cavity RTD is reading an open circuit. Oven heating is disabled. Check sensor plug at the rear of the oven.

fixSteps.title: Inspect sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Remove rear panel and check RTD plug.

title: Oven temperature sensor short circuit
shortDescription: RTD reads short — oven disables heating.
fullDescription: F2 means the RTD is reading below valid range (shorted). Replace sensor.

title: Keypad stuck
shortDescription: Control keypad reports a stuck button.
fullDescription: F3 appears when the controller detects a button held continuously for longer than 60 seconds, often due to moisture or a mechanical issue. Clean the keypad and power cycle.

fixSteps.title: Clean and dry
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe keypad dry with soft cloth.

faq.a: No, oven locks out on F3.

title: Door latch fault
shortDescription: Door lock motor did not reach expected position.
fullDescription: F4 is raised during self-clean when the motorized door latch does not fully engage within the timeout. Cancel self-clean and inspect latch mechanism.

fixSteps.title: Cancel cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Press Cancel, let oven cool fully.

videoSearchQuery: Fisher Paykel oven F4 door lock

title: Cooling fan fault
fullDescription: F5 means the PCB cooling fan is not reporting rotation. Without it, internal electronics can overheat and the oven will shut down. Check fan for obstruction and replace if needed.
videoSearchQuery: Fisher Paykel oven cooling fan F5

faq.a: No — power off to prevent damage.

title: Convection fan fault
shortDescription: Convection fan not reaching expected RPM.
fullDescription: F6 indicates the convection fan motor has stalled or is reporting low speed feedback. Convection cooking is disabled. Bake/broil may still work.

fixSteps.title: Inspect fan
fixSteps.instruction: Remove rear oven liner and check fan can spin freely.

videoSearchQuery: Fisher Paykel oven F6 convection fan

title: Over-temperature detected
fullDescription: F7 is a safety code raised when cavity temp rises faster or higher than expected. Typically a stuck relay feeding the bake element. Disconnect power immediately.
videoSearchQuery: Fisher Paykel oven F7 over temp

title: Meat probe fault
shortDescription: External meat probe reads invalid value.
fullDescription: F8 is raised when a meat probe is plugged in but reads out of range. Unplug probe if not in use; if in use, replace with a genuine F&P probe.

fixSteps.title: Unplug probe
fixSteps.instruction: Remove probe and see if F8 clears.

title: Door sense fault
shortDescription: Door switch or position sensor disagreement.
fullDescription: F9 is raised when the door switch reports open but latch reports closed, or vice versa. Often caused by a misaligned strike after moving the oven.

title: Control board communication fault
shortDescription: UI and main board cannot communicate.
fullDescription: F10 appears when bus communication between user interface and main board fails. Power cycle resolves most transient cases.
